assessments.summary: The supplied argument establishes the unconditional finite-auxiliary bounds, superadditivity, Fekete limit, exact scaling under independent repetition, RTD closed form, and certified strict decimal intervals. It also correctly establishes the super-symbol capacity lower bound and threshold equivalences only under the expressly stated hypotheses.
scopeQualifications: The capacity lower bound C_sum(P) >= M_n^fin(P)/n and the resulting Fekete-limit lower bound are conditional on (H-Marton).
The identity M_1^fin(P)=L_RTD is conditional on (H-binary).
Equivalence between improvement over RTD and improvement over the complete one-letter Marton optimum requires both (H-Marton) and (H-binary).
All optimizations defining M_n^fin(P) are restricted to finite auxiliary alphabets; no optimizer or cardinality theorem is assumed.
No fixed-n equality is asserted or used as a capacity converse.
The declared transaction is corrective/provenance material only and is not a mathematical dependency.
